title: The degree-zero unit belongs to the degree-zero subgroup.
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $\mathcal A$ be a quasi-coherent commutative $\mathcal O_X$-algebra sheaf [def-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra], with structure morphism $\alpha:\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal A$ [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Let $(B_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules equipped with a commutative unital graded sheaf algebra structure [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures], whose unit is $\eta:\mathcal O_X\to B_0$. Suppose a specified isomorphism of underlying module sheaves $d:\bigoplus_{n\ge0}B_n\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal A$ respects the multiplication and the unit. Write $i_n:B_n\to\mathcal A$ for its composite with the $n$th coproduct inclusion; unit compatibility means $i_0(U)(\eta_U(r))=\alpha_U(r)$ for every open $U\subseteq X$ and every $r\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$. For an affine open $V\subseteq X$, put $C_V=\Gamma(V,\mathcal A)$ and define the additive subgroup $C_{V,n}=\operatorname{im}(i_n(V):\Gamma(V,B_n)\to C_V)$. Then $1_{C_V}\in C_{V,0}$. These are the section ring and image subgroups denoted by $A.\mathrm{sections}(V)$ and $A.\mathrm{sectionGrade}(V,n)$ for the given relative Proj input algebra $A$.
